name: Panta PACCAR MX-13 2013-2016 Fault Code Reference
source: Diesel Repair / Diesel Laptops - PACCAR MX-13 (2013-2016) Fault Codes List
usage_note: Curated retrieval index from the supplied Diesel Repair source. Preserve exact P-code/SPN/FMI combinations when available. The source contains some rows with blank SPN or FMI and at least one apparent typographical SPN; do not silently infer missing values. Verify repair procedures and specifications against current PACCAR service information for the exact engine and calibration.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 2013-2016 diagnostic scope
documents.summary: Diesel Repair describes the 2013-2016 PACCAR MX-13 as a 12.9L common-rail engine using SCR and DPF emissions systems, rated in the source at 405-510 hp and up to 1,850 lb-ft, used in Class 8 applications including Peterbilt 579 and Kenworth T680. The source provides P-code, SPN, FMI and title where available.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 common-rail fuel pressure and pump faults
documents.summary: Source coverage includes P0087/SPN94 FMI1 low fuel pressure; P0088/SPN1442 FMI7 high fuel pressure; P0093/SPN157 sudden common-rail pressure drop; P0094/SPN1347 FMI16 pump-unit control incorrect; P009F/SPN5571 FMI2 pressure-release-valve malfunction; P0192/P0193 SPN157 rail-pressure sensor circuit low/high; pump-unit 1 and 2 electrical faults; P1086/SPN94 FMI17 rail-pressure increase too slow; P1087/SPN94 FMI18 moderately low fuel pressure; P1088-P1090 high rail pressure; P1091/SPN157 FMI16 rail-pressure data erratic; P109C/P109D release-valve current faults; and P128E/P128F control incorrect.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 cylinder contribution and misfire faults
documents.summary: The source lists low torque contribution for cylinders 1-6 and individual misfire/contribution faults P0301-P0306, plus P0315 cylinder unbalance and P1301-P1306 intermittent misfire. Preserve the exact cylinder and code. Diagnose fuel, compression, injector/electrical and related conditions rather than treating a misfire code as automatic injector failure.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 crankshaft and camshaft synchronization faults
documents.summary: Source codes include P0016/SPN723 FMI8 cam speed not corresponding with engine position, P0017/SPN190 FMI8 crank speed not corresponding, P0335 crank signal disturbed/no signal during operation, P0340/P0341 cam signal disturbed/out of range, and start-specific P1335/P1336 crank and P1340/P1341 cam signal faults.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 air, VTG turbo and BPV faults
documents.summary: The source covers VTG turbo actuator position/internal faults, turbo overspeed, manifold/inlet pressure plausibility and circuit faults, exhaust pressure before turbine/after BPV, VTG control incorrect, airflow high/low during overrun, actuator power/learning/temperature faults and turbo-speed high/low. Exact P-code distinguishes sensor, actuator, pressure, plausibility and mechanical/turbine conditions.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 EGR and crankcase ventilation faults
documents.summary: Diesel Repair lists EGR differential-pressure sensor circuit/plausibility faults, EGR temperature faults, inability to reach target, EGR mass-flow/rate faults, EGR valve-module position/current/internal faults, stuck-closed and flow-while-closed conditions, plus crankcase pressure and ventilation-module speed/leakage faults.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 coolant, oil and fan faults
documents.summary: Source coverage includes coolant pump speed/stall, coolant-temperature plausibility/circuit/high-temperature warnings, engine-oil temperature circuit/high-temperature faults, oil-pressure circuit low/high and severe/moderate low-pressure faults, coolant level low, extensive oil-level circuit/plausibility/low/high conditions, and fan control/speed faults.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 ECU power, sensor supply and internal faults
documents.summary: The source lists PCI ECU supply voltage low/high, internal ECU and software faults, injector-power generation faults, internal ECU temperature faults, 5V sensor-supply high/low faults and multiple SPN629 internal/software error codes. Verify batteries, charging, feeds, grounds, connectors and shared reference circuits before condemning the ECU.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 DPF, DEF and aftertreatment faults
documents.summary: Source entries include DEF dosing malfunction P1514/SPN4349 FMI7; aftertreatment malfunction P1516/SPN5246 FMI14; DEF quality P1517/SPN3364 FMI18; torque derate and staged DEF level/speed-limit conditions; DPF regeneration-switch CAN faults P2458/P2459; PM sensor circuit, DOC compensation, dosing compensation, DPF efficiency/not-detected/frequent-regen, exhaust-temperature and DPF differential-pressure conditions; and P3796 DPF soot level most severe.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 CAN, vehicle controls and immobilizer faults
documents.summary: The source includes CAN out-of-range messages for remote accelerator, cruise resume/set, brake switch and requested fan speed; speed-function/downhill/retarder/cruise switch faults; vehicle-speed sensor electrical/frequency/range faults; and P0513/SPN1195 FMI14 immobilizer not matched.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 engine protection and derate states
documents.summary: The source identifies P1105/SPN1109 FMI11 as approaching engine shutdown, P1106 as power derate active, P1495/SPN1787 FMI11 as engine-protection power derate active and P1496/SPN3821 FMI11 as protection mode active. Treat protection-state codes as consequences and diagnose the triggering active faults.
